findings.title: Central admin (branch_id=0) on Le Cayenne single-branch relies on 5s polling, not Echo push
findings.detail: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1844 returns early on branchId<=0. For Le Cayenne V1 the central admin user (admin@lecayenne.fr) viewing /kds will NOT receive Echo push — only the 5s polling fallback. Documented intentional behavior ([P4-1] inline). Wave Polish Final empirical ΔT≈1s suggests staff-role login was used OR polling cadence captured the order at the next tick. For acceptance, the V1.1 spec target ≤10s is comfortably met by 5s polling.
findings.remediation: None needed for V1. If empirically tighter latency is desired for central admin (branchCount>1 install), revise the branchId<=0 early-return to authorize Echo subscription for Admin / Tenant Admin roles (mirrors channels.php:60 server-side auth). Backlog candidate.

findings.title: Debounce window 300ms coalesces burst broadcasts — visible as 1 refresh for 3 orders within 2s
findings.detail: KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:2334 wraps refresh in 300ms setTimeout. Race condition V1.5 (3 orders in 2s window) results in a single list()+items() pair after the 3rd OrderCreated frame settles. All 3 orders ARE in the refreshed payload — no order lost. Net wall-clock to display 3rd order ≈ broadcast_latency + 300ms ≤ ≤10s target.

verdict_reasoning: All 5 verifications confirmed via code-static analysis + corroborating empirical evidence from prior cycles. (1) ΔT happy path: Wave Polish Final ~1s + rush-100 35-order success on the same branch. (2) Echo channel correctly wired backend → frontend with auth gates closed. (3) Polling fallback 5s when WS down, 60s passive when WS up — meets the ≤5s budget cited in spec. (4) composition_snapshot frozen at insert in same DB transaction, no mutation code path exists. (5) Race condition handled idempotently by outbox firstOrCreate + frontend 300ms debounce coalescing. NF525 fiscal chain gap-free under load (rush-100 proof). No P0 / P1 findings.
